black_scholes.title: Black–Scholes
black_scholes.intro: Explore option prices in 3D. The research below looks at approximating a digital option with a call spread and hedging it at fixed intervals.
black_scholes.research: Narrower spreads improve the payoff approximation and increase hedging error. In the 64-step experiment, the direct digital hedge had the lowest total RMSE among the strategies tested.
black_scholes.figure_caption: Payoff approximation, hedging, and total error across call-spread widths, with 64 rebalancing intervals.
black_scholes.figure_alt: Line chart of payoff approximation, pure hedging, total, and equal-capital total RMSE versus call-spread width at 64 rebalancing intervals.
black_scholes.study_intro: A digital option pays 1 if the underlying finishes at or above the strike. This study approximates that payoff with a normalized call spread and examines how spread width affects discrete Delta hedging.
black_scholes.study_setup: S₀ = K = 1 · σ = 20% · T = 1 year · r = 0 · 64 rebalancing intervals

pricing_background.model: The Black–Scholes model prices a European call with payoff max(S − K, 0) at maturity, constant volatility, and a constant risk-free rate.
pricing_background.error: Signed error is the selected numerical price minus the analytical price on the same grid. Absolute error is its magnitude.
pricing_background.analytical: Analytical uses the closed-form Black–Scholes formula.
pricing_background.implicit: Implicit solves a linear system at each time step.
pricing_background.cn: CN Direct uses Crank–Nicolson time stepping for second-order accuracy in time.
pricing_background.rannacher: Rannacher stepping starts with four implicit substeps before continuing with Crank–Nicolson to damp early oscillations.
pricing_background.r: Annual risk-free rate, entered as a percentage.
pricing_background.sigma: Annual volatility, entered as a percentage.
pricing_background.axes: The surface spans spot prices S from 0 to 4K and time to expiry from 0 to T. Height represents call price or pricing error.

hedging_background.payoff: A normalized call spread buys a call at strike K and sells a call at K + h, with both positions scaled by 1/h. Its payoff rises from 0 to 1 between the strikes; h is the spread width.
hedging_background.hedge: The stock holding is reset to the call-spread Delta at 64 equally spaced rebalancing dates, with the balance held in cash. Direct digital Delta hedging provides the benchmark.
hedging_background.payoff_error: Payoff approximation measures the difference between the call-spread and digital payoffs at maturity.
hedging_background.hedging_error: Pure hedging measures the portfolio’s terminal error relative to the call-spread payoff.
hedging_background.total_error: Total measures the portfolio’s terminal error relative to the digital payoff, including the cross term between hedging and payoff approximation errors.
hedging_background.capital_error: Equal-capital total adjusts initial cash so every strategy starts with the digital option price. All four measures are root mean square errors (RMSE).

eeg.title: EEG & Perception
eeg.intro: This study asks whether emotional imagery changes adolescents’ visual judgments and EEG responses. It compares pure perception with congruent and incongruent imagery.
eeg.figure_caption: Average ERP waveforms and scalp maps for pure perception, congruent imagery, and incongruent imagery in the N1 and P300 time windows.
eeg.figure_alt: Two panels show group-average N1 and P300 ERP waveforms and scalp maps for pure perception, congruent imagery, and incongruent imagery.

polar_station.title: Polar Station
polar_station.intro: A native agent development environment unifying local and SSH workspaces, terminal sessions, AI coding agents, and voice input.
polar_station.development: Built with AI coding agents using modular Rust infrastructure and Ghostty terminals. A Godot-based 3D data analysis and visualization platform is in development, with a preliminary prototype available.
